messages:
nina.sales: Heads-up 10k ARR prospect (Assembla Health) wants a short 3-day eval. Request: upload SOC2 artifacts + vendor pen-test PDF into our dataroom. They asked for us to host the ZIP for reviewers. Can we take raw files?
carlos.sec: We can, but insist on presigned upload, short retention, and vendor-signed attestation. Also need to lock the scan window to avoid noisy traffic during peak.
ev an.ops: (typo) ops note: we can provision presigned path under `assembla/poc/` with 7-day lifecycle. Presign TTL 72h. Will enable audit logs on that prefix.
tara.legal: I'll prepare the pen-test attestation template. Suggest retention default 14 days and explicit redaction window of 7 days. Also add clause: "Redwood acts as custodian only; redaction requests come from customer."
audit-bot: presign-link-ready: https://dataroom.redwood.test/presign/assembla-poc?ttl=3d (example). Generated at 1759876601. :white_check_mark:
maya.eng: For scan window, recommend Thurs 02:00-04:00 PT. GPU staging needed for repro, can reserve a small canary slot free day-0. If they want dedicated nodes for reproducing, charge applies.
nina.sales: Buyer also asked if Redwood will coordinate signature with the external vendor (they prefer hands-off). We usually offer vendor-liaison as a paid service.
carlos.sec: Pen-test attestation snippet we need in vendor letter:

``
Attestation needed:
- Scope: staging CIDRs and listed hostnames
- Retention: Redwood will retain raw reports for 14 days after upload
- Redaction: Customer may request redaction within 7 days; Redwood will produce a redacted bundle within 48 hours
- Sharing: Vendor confirms reports may be shared with customer-designated auditors
``

tara.legal: I'll include that snippet and mark vendor-liaison as optional in SOW. Also: require vendor to acknowledge that Redwood will not be liable for vendor content.
ev an.ops: Presign path ready; will lock TTL to 72h. I'll DM final S3 URL to nina when vendor signs.
maya.eng: Confirmed canary slot reserved for Thursday start. If they need reproduction on dedicated nodes, ops will quote +$900/day.
nina.sales: OK I'll update the quote: "POC reserved compute", "Compliance ingest (14 days) - free first 3 days", "Vendor liaison (optional)", "Redaction SOW (optional)". Sending to buyer after vendor signs attestation.
carlos.sec: One more: if the raw reports include sensitive internal IPs, we must require redaction before any external distribution. Add that to attestation.
tara.legal: Added the clause. Draft uploaded to dataroom and vendor looped in.
audit-bot: vendor-signed-attestation: pending. Generated at 1759876678.
nina.sales: Thanks all  will close when vendor signs and I'll post the final presign URL. :pray:
